recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core edit is needed for FHIR-23722 unless a future work-group decision changes the graph-connected message Bundle model; such work should be handled through the later graph/reference issue family rather than restating the 2019 wording.
issue_request: FHIR-23722 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core messaging change request asking the messaging page to state that a message Bundle includes the MessageHeader, resources referenced by MessageHeader.focus and MessageHeader.response.details, may include additional connected resources, and should include resources needed to process MessageHeader.event.
initial_application: Git commit 5f469dee282a284b707d08a47f140a2467150b23 directly applied FHIR-23722 by expanding source/messaging.html into explicit message Bundle rules covering MessageHeader, focus/response-details resources, additional resources, and graph/traversal constraints.
additional_context: FHIR-25257 later required every resource in a message Bundle to be connected directly or indirectly to MessageHeader, and FHIR-43295 later clarified that the message and document must-link requirements are met through RESTful references. Current source/messaging.html therefore correctly uses connected-graph wording with Reference.reference, canonical, or URI links rather than preserving the older literal resolution text verbatim.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/messaging.html already requires MessageHeader as the first message Bundle entry, includes any MessageHeader.focus and MessageHeader.response.details resources, permits needed additional resources, prohibits resources outside a connected graph including MessageHeader, and repeats the connected-graph rule in Basic Messaging Assumptions.
